hints.title: Lexicographical Rank Equivalence
hints.text: Each operation transitions to the preceding lexicographical permutation, meaning the answer is the 0-based permutation rank of s.

hints.title: Multiset Permutation Counting
hints.text: At each position i, count smaller characters c < s[i] and calculate valid arrangements of the remaining multiset.

hints.title: Modular Inverse Factorials
hints.text: Multiply count(c) by the factorial of rem - 1 divided by the product of remaining character factorials using modular inverse.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating the operations step by step takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Combinatorial ranking with precomputed factorials and modular inverse evaluates rank in O(n * 26) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that operations correspond exactly to multiset permutation rank.
